scoring.partial_policy: competency-specific; do not assume 50% unless explicitly configured
scoring.na_policy: full weight credited and retained in denominator; only where competency rule allows N/A; mandatory reason
scoring.critical_override: Fake Booking and Wrong Call Tagging force final call score to 0; retain competency marks
scoring.critical_zero: flag for human review/risk; not a generic final-score override
scoring.crm_integrity: 10 points; N/A prohibited; Full=10, Partial=5, Zero=0; checks are diagnostic and non-additive

competencies.name: Greeting & Introduction
competencies.definition: CRE opens professionally, greets the customer, identifies herself and Kataria.
competencies.partial: Greeting or introduction is present but incomplete.
competencies.zero: Neither a usable greeting nor introduction.

competencies.name: Recording Disclosure & Compliance
competencies.definition: CRE clearly discloses call recording near the beginning.
competencies.partial: Disclosure is incomplete or unclear but recognizably attempted.
competencies.zero: Missing, materially unclear, or too late.
competencies.na_rule: Only when the customer interrupts before disclosure can be completed; otherwise N/A is prohibited.

competencies.name: Permission to Talk
competencies.definition: CRE checks whether the customer can talk before proceeding.
competencies.partial: Indirect/ambiguous check that reasonably seeks availability.

competencies.name: Customer & Vehicle Identification
competencies.definition: CRE confirms the customer and vehicle identity accurately.
competencies.full: Both customer and vehicle are confirmed.
competencies.zero: Neither is confirmed or identity is materially wrong.

competencies.name: Purpose & Context Establishment
competencies.definition: CRE explains why the call is being made and establishes relevant context.
competencies.full: Purpose is clear and contextually appropriate.
competencies.partial: Purpose is vague or context is incomplete.
competencies.zero: Purpose is missing or materially misleading.

competencies.name: Customer & Vehicle Understanding
competencies.definition: CRE understands the customer's need and relevant vehicle/service context.
competencies.full: Relevant facts are understood and reflected in the response.

competencies.name: Service Knowledge & Accuracy
competencies.definition: CRE provides accurate, relevant service information based on available customer/vehicle context.
competencies.partial: Generally correct but incomplete or insufficiently tailored.
competencies.zero: Materially incorrect, misleading, or fails an applicable service-information requirement.

competencies.name: Value Communication
competencies.definition: CRE communicates eligible customer benefits/offers when supported by CRM and call context.
competencies.full: Relevant eligible value/benefit is accurately communicated.
competencies.partial: Offer/benefit is attempted but incomplete or unclear.
competencies.zero: Eligible benefit is ignored or communicated misleadingly.
competencies.na_rule: N/A only when CRM/context establishes no eligible product or opportunity.

competencies.name: Customer Interaction & Resolution
competencies.definition: CRE listens, responds appropriately, handles questions/objections and resolves or responsibly routes concerns.
competencies.full: Acknowledges concern, responds appropriately and gives a workable resolution/next step.
competencies.partial: Response is adequate but generic or incomplete.
competencies.zero: Dismissive, inappropriate, argumentative, or leaves a material concern unmanaged.

competencies.name: Customer Action & Disposition
competencies.definition: Call outcome and customer action/decision are clear; CRE accurately reflects the disposition.
competencies.full: Outcome/decision and next action are clear; refusal itself is not penalized.
competencies.partial: Outcome is broadly clear but important action detail is missing.
competencies.zero: Outcome is missing, contradicted, or materially misrepresented.

competencies.name: CRM & Documentation Integrity
competencies.definition: CRM disposition, task/follow-up, CRE remarks and applicable customer remarks accurately reflect the call.
competencies.full: All applicable CRM/documentation checks are accurate and complete.
competencies.partial: Minor documentation defect without material outcome distortion.
competencies.zero: Missing mandatory CRE remarks or material CRM inconsistency, incorrect/misleading tagging, or material inaccurate documentation.
competencies.aggregation: Non-additive checks: Booking, Follow-up, SNR, Escalation, CRE remarks, Customer remarks. Full=10, Partial=5, Zero=0. Correct checks cannot compensate for a material failure.

competencies.name: Professional Communication & Closure
competencies.definition: CRE communicates clearly, respectfully and professionally and closes the interaction appropriately.
competencies.full: Clear, courteous, composed communication and suitable closure/thanks.
competencies.partial: Generally professional but closure or communication has a minor gap.
competencies.zero: Unprofessional, disrespectful, confusing, or no appropriate closure.
